rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Collector road kerb by a roundabout, houses 8-11 m away, no parking.
reasons: Through road, no parked cars seen

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 8-11 m from the kerb for the whole stretch, closest at 62 m along (10 m).
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb meets fences and driveways; no pull-off or verge wide enough to leave the lane.
drivers.traffic: Collector road with traffic into a roundabout.
drivers.convention: No marked parking lane; cars in the lane are moving, not parked.

sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the road, mainly from the south; north kerb partly open.

best_section.where: north kerb of Jerrang Street, short of the roundabout
